top_signals.title: AI Tools Reshape the Black Friday Experience
top_signals.summary:
As the holiday shopping season ramps up, retail sales are expected to top $1 trillion for the first time, with shoppers indicating they will spend more this year than last. 
They are also expected to give AI more say over what they buy.
Anjee Solanki, National Director of Retail, US at Colliers, explains what the first true "agentic AI" holiday season means for shoppers. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
